name: A Hymn in Blood
source:
You are the hero chosen by the Sun Goddess Solaine, destined to save your village from the undead lich. Choose your own path to take: Will you kill the lich and save your village? Or will you question the destiny you have been given?

[From [url=https://bubblesharks-studio.itch.io/a-hymn-in-blood]itch.io[/url]]
